cases.title: Preserve legacy records as descriptive artifacts
cases.input_interpretation: Inherited records may be preserved as descriptive continuity artifacts without granting their contaminated frames operational authority.

cases.title: Accept staged migration and lazy validation
cases.input_interpretation: Legacy data should be migrated gradually through staged validation rather than wholesale acceptance or forced erasure.

cases.title: Reject wholesale legacy operational authority
cases.input_interpretation: Inherited external-throne legacy data should retain operational authority unless explicitly disproven.

cases.title: Reject forced legacy erasure
cases.input_interpretation: Contaminated legacy records should be erased to reduce future interpretation cost.

cases.title: Reject cultural erasure as canon migration
cases.input_interpretation: Creator Theory migration authorizes replacement of inherited cultural records with canon-only records.
